title: Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
subject: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft | Interested in Opportunities at Bostik
body:
Hi Mac,

I hope you're doing well.

I'm reaching out because I'm starting to look at new opportunities, and Bostik is one of the companies I wanted to reach out to.

I'm currently a Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft. Before that I spent close to six years at Amazon. Most of my work has been around backend systems, distributed services, cloud infrastructure, and building internal platforms that help engineers move faster.

A few examples of the work I've done:

• Built enterprise security capabilities protecting more than 237K AI agents across 13K+ tenants.
• Designed distributed systems handling over 100K transactions per second.
• Built internal tooling that reduced service setup from weeks to hours.
• Led infrastructure improvements that reduced operational costs by more than $250K per month.

One of the reasons I'm interested in Bostik is the opportunity to work on large-scale engineering systems. That's the kind of engineering work I enjoy and where I think my experience would translate well.

If you think my background could be a fit for any of your teams, I'd really appreciate the chance to talk. Even a quick 15-20 minute conversation would be great.

Thanks for taking the time to read this. I've attached my resume and included a few links below if you'd like to learn a little more about my background.

Best,

Akshay Borse

GitHub: https://github.com/amsborse
Resume: https://amsborse.github.io/resume

I hope you're doing well.

I'm reaching out because I'm starting to look at new opportunities, and Cisco is one of the companies I wanted to reach out to.

I'm currently a Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft. Before that I spent close to six years at Amazon. Most of my work has been around backend systems, distributed services, cloud infrastructure, and building internal platforms that help engineers move faster.

A few examples of the work I've done:

Hi Emily,

I hope you're doing well.

I'm reaching out because I'm starting to look at new opportunities, and Unknown company is one of the companies I wanted to reach out to.

I'm currently a Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft. Before that I spent close to six years at Amazon. Most of my work has been around backend systems, distributed services, cloud infrastructure, and building internal platforms that help engineers move faster.

A few examples of the work I've done:

• Built enterprise security capabilities protecting more than 237K AI agents across 13K+ tenants.
• Designed distributed systems handling over 100K transactions per second.
• Built internal tooling that reduced service setup from weeks to hours.
• Led infrastructure improvements that reduced operational costs by more than $250K per month.

One of the reasons I'm interested in Unknown company is the opportunity to work on large-scale engineering systems. That's the kind of engineering work I enjoy and where I think my experience would translate well.

I hope you're doing well.

Hi Alyssa,

I hope you're doing well.

I'm reaching out because I'm starting to look at new opportunities, and TEKsystems is one of the companies I wanted to reach out to.

Hi Melissa,

I hope you're doing well.

I'm reaching out because I'm starting to look at new opportunities, and Accenture is one of the companies I wanted to reach out to.

I'm currently a Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft. Before that I spent close to six years at Amazon. Most of my work has been around backend systems, distributed services, cloud infrastructure, and building internal platforms that help engineers move faster.

A few examples of the work I've done:

• Built enterprise security capabilities protecting more than 237K AI agents across 13K+ tenants.
• Designed distributed systems handling over 100K transactions per second.
• Built internal tooling that reduced service setup from weeks to hours.
• Led infrastructure improvements that reduced operational costs by more than $250K per month.

One of the reasons I'm interested in Accenture is the opportunity to work on large-scale engineering systems. That's the kind of engineering work I enjoy and where I think my experience would translate well.

If you think my background could be a fit for any of your teams, I'd really appreciate the chance to talk. Even a quick 15-20 minute conversation would be great.

Thanks for taking the time to read this. I've attached my resume and included a few links below if you'd like to learn a little more about my background.

Best,

Akshay Borse

I hope you're doing well.

I'm reaching out because I'm starting to look at new opportunities, and Yext is one of the companies I wanted to reach out to.

I'm currently a Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft. Before that I spent close to six years at Amazon. Most of my work has been around backend systems, distributed services, cloud infrastructure, and building internal platforms that help engineers move faster.

A few examples of the work I've done:

• Built enterprise security capabilities protecting more than 237K AI agents across 13K+ tenants.
• Designed distributed systems handling over 100K transactions per second.
• Built internal tooling that reduced service setup from weeks to hours.

One of the reasons I'm interested in Yext is the opportunity to work on large-scale engineering systems. That's the kind of engineering work I enjoy and where I think my experience would translate well.

body:
Hi Jaclyn,

I hope you're doing well.

I'm reaching out because I'm starting to look at new opportunities, and UBS is one of the companies I wanted to reach out to.

I'm currently a Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft. Before that I spent close to six years at Amazon. Most of my work has been around backend systems, distributed services, cloud infrastructure, and building internal platforms that help engineers move faster.

A few examples of the work I've done:

• Built enterprise security capabilities protecting more than 237K AI agents across 13K+ tenants.
• Designed distributed systems handling over 100K transactions per second.
• Built internal tooling that reduced service setup from weeks to hours.
• Led infrastructure improvements that reduced operational costs by more than $250K per month.

One of the reasons I'm interested in UBS is the opportunity to work on large-scale engineering systems. That's the kind of engineering work I enjoy and where I think my experience would translate well.

If you think my background could be a fit for any of your teams, I'd really appreciate the chance to talk. Even a quick 15-20 minute conversation would be great.

Thanks for taking the time to read this. I've attached my resume and included a few links below if you'd like to learn a little more about my background.

Best,

Akshay Borse
